rules: Single source of truth for what to build. Work on ONE feature at a time (state 'active'). Never set 'passing' by hand: only `npm run verify -- <id>` may do that. Agents may change state between not_started/active/blocked and edit 'notes'.

features.behavior: User can add an expense (amount, currency, date, description) and sees it in a list on the home page, newest first, persisted in Postgres with userId from getCurrentUser()
features.verification: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npx playwright test e2e/add-expense.spec.ts
features.notes: Amounts stored as integer minor units + ISO currency code, never floats.

features.behavior: Walking skeleton on Azure: Bicep provisions Container App (Easy Auth with Entra ID, restricted to the owner), PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Storage account and Key Vault with managed identity; a CI/CD pipeline builds the Docker image, runs migrations and deploys; the e2e smoke and add-expense tests pass against the deployed URL
features.verification: az bicep build --file infra/main.bicep && E2E_BASE_URL=$APP_URL npx playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/add-expense.spec.ts
features.notes: CI/CD: GitHub Actions with OIDC login to Azure, images in ACR (DECISIONS.md D7). Requires a GitHub repo + Entra app registration with federated credential. E2E against Easy Auth needs a test identity or a bypass for the test run; decide when starting.

features.behavior: User can edit and delete an expense; list shows the total for the current month
features.verification: npm run check && npx playwright test e2e/edit-delete-expense.spec.ts

features.behavior: User can attach a receipt image (jpg/png/pdf, max 10 MB) to an expense; it is stored in Blob Storage and can be viewed from the expense
features.verification: npm run check && npx playwright test e2e/receipt-upload.spec.ts

features.behavior: Uploading a receipt runs OCR through a ReceiptParser interface (Azure AI Document Intelligence prebuilt-receipt) and returns amount, currency, date and merchant; fixture receipts in tests/fixtures/receipts parse to their expected values
features.verification: npm run check && npx vitest run src/receipts
features.notes: E2E uses a stub ReceiptParser; the live-service fixture test is opt-in via an env var.

features.behavior: Creating an expense from a receipt pre-fills the form with OCR results; the user reviews and corrects the fields before saving
features.verification: npm run check && npx playwright test e2e/expense-from-receipt.spec.ts

features.behavior: Expenses have a category; the list can be filtered by category
features.verification: npm run check && npx playwright test e2e/categories.spec.ts
